name: Georgetown
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Georgetown?
answer_short: Yes, under the state rule. In Georgetown, a permitted golf cart may use secondary roads posted 35 mph or less, in daylight, within 4 miles of the registration address. US 17, US 521 and US 701 are primary highways.

golf_cart.roads: Secondary roads posted 35 mph or less

rules.rule: Permitted golf carts on secondary roads posted 35 mph or less, in daylight, within 4 miles of the registration address, unless the city sets a different hour rule
No golf carts on US 17, US 521 or US 701

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Georgetown?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on US 17 in Georgetown?
faq.a: No. US 17 is a primary highway.

faq.q: How far can I drive from home?
faq.a: Within 4 miles of the address on the cart's registration, on a secondary road posted 35 mph or less.
